name: ballerina/serdes

typeDefs.name: Schema
typeDefs.description: A Schema object that can be used to create custom serializers/deserializers.

typeDefs.name: Error
typeDefs.description: Represents any error related to Ballerina SerDes module

typeDefs.name: Proto3Schema
typeDefs.description: Generates a schema for a given data type.

functions.name: init
functions.description: Generates a schema for a given data type.

parameters.name: ballerinaDataType
parameters.description: The data type of the value that needs to be serialized

return.description: A `serdes:Error` if the data type is not supported or else `()`

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: The value that is being serialized

return.description: A byte array corresponding to the encoded value

functions.name: deserialize
functions.description: Deserializes a given array of bytes.

parameters.name: encodedMessage
parameters.description: The encoded byte array of the value that is serialized

parameters.name: T
parameters.description: The type of the deserialized data. This will be inferred from the expected type

return.description: The value represented by the encoded byte array
